body:
Publishes an attributed verification/research note: [Verification of the odd-period focal inversion area product](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23425494). The published PDF, TeX source and verification ZIP were independently downloaded and matched to the reviewed package; the DOI resolves to the same record.

For a proper nested confocal ellipse pair admitting an odd primitive Poncelet billiard family, the product of the signed areas obtained by unit-circle inversion of the original orbit vertices in the two original foci is constant along each admitted family, including all coprime stars and reversal. For every integer r>=1, repeating an odd primitive cycle r times scales each signed area by r and the product by r squared.

Attributed verification/research note: the historical RGK k903,a target is Table10 on page12, row k903,a dated10/20 (October2020); RGH N=3 and Conjecture1 are credited. Alper Ferudun, DOI10.5281/zenodo.23096994, treats the same target with substantially the same compact flag-curve mechanism. The RGH public-preprint delta defect is disclosed; journal full text/typography were uninspected and no general corrected RGH formula is claimed. Chavez-Caliz DOI10.1007/s40598-020-00154-8 is used. No theorem/formula/method novelty, absolute firstness, certified discovery independence, literal simultaneity or current-open status is claimed. Specified GitHub/Zenodo record dates do not certify first public availability of every byte or repository visibility history. The original PR creation timestamp is 2026-10-01T05:36:26Z; the cited Ferudun v1.0 record reports creation at 2026-10-02T07:08:59.065762+00:00. These are recorded chronology facts, not a certificate of first public availability or independent discovery.

The package contains a self-contained flag-curve proof, a portable exact verifier for four specified convex winding-one controls, normal/optimized execution receipts and deliberate negative controls. Finite verification checks do not prove the all-period theorem. Two fresh whole-package adversarial reviews were accepted after repairs. AI tools were used extensively in research, proof development, drafting, auditing and computation. The note is unrefereed and has not undergone conventional human peer review or proof-assistant certification.

Original submitted claimed_solved1/5 is preserved; author turns and actual model/reasoning effort remain unverified. Four Git commits are not four author turns; later audits are separate. The audit preserves the original submitted HEAD and native authored range. The merge installs repaired current verifier presentations alongside the credited publication. Audit and provenance: [PR206 case](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/tree/main/draft_pr_publication_program_20260930/audits/pr206_5100062).
